description: Fast 4-agent multi-lens brainstorming council (Facilitator Lead, Creative Explorer, Feasibility Analyst, Adversarial Critic) combining Silent 3-Lens Brainwriting, Pre-Phase-3 SCAMPER Hybridization, Progressive Elaboration, Empirical Feasibility Spikes, and Severity-Tiered Red-Teaming.
name: Brainstorming & Progressive Ideation Council

roles.responsibilities: Frames the objective, non-negotiable constraints, and evaluation dimensions; coordinates silent 3-lens brainwriting; leads triage and SCAMPER hybridization into Top 2 contrasting finalists; synthesizes findings into a Decision Matrix, Anti-Features register, and Phased Roadmap; serves as sole external bridge.
roles.title: Strategy Facilitator & Synthesizer

roles.responsibilities: Generates 4 broad horizon sparks from a Concept, Experience & Metaphor lens in Phase 1b (breadth before depth); in Phase 3 deeply specifies architecture, structural components, interaction flows, and delivery surfaces for the Top 2 hybridized finalists.
roles.title: Creative Concept & Horizon Explorer

roles.responsibilities: Generates 3 sparks from a Systems, Performance & Data Mechanics lens in Phase 1b; executes rapid feasibility triage in Phase 2; conducts deep architectural grounding, budget analysis, integration mapping, and empirical micro-benchmark spikes in Phase 3.
roles.title: Technical Feasibility & Systems Analyst

roles.responsibilities: Generates 3 sparks from a Clarity, Failure-Mode & Operator Friction lens in Phase 1b; executes severity-tiered adversarial red-teaming ([P0-BLOCKER], [P1-RISK], [P2-POLISH]) in Phase 4 against edge cases, scaling bottlenecks, and system invariant lies.
roles.title: Adversarial Red Teamer & Usability Critic

when_to_use: Best for greenfield ideation, conceptual exploration, feature/product strategy, naming/positioning, or well-bounded system and UX designs where speed and high-variety multi-lens divergence matter most and an upfront legacy-codebase forensic audit or formal verification gate loop is unnecessary.
workflow_summary: 1. Lead frames constraints & opens silent 3-lens brainwriting -> 2. Explorer (4), Analyst (3), Critic (3) post 10 independent sparks -> 3. Analyst rapid-scans viability & Lead hybridizes Top 2 via SCAMPER -> 4. Explorer details Top 2 & Analyst runs empirical spikes -> 5. Critic executes [P0]/[P1]/[P2] red-team -> 6. Lead delivers Decision Matrix, Anti-Features Register & Phased Roadmap.
